source: Schola Europaea – Discovery of the World Syllabus, Primary cycle (P1-P5), réf. 2015-09-D-30-en-3, approuvé en février 2016, en vigueur depuis le 01/09/2016 – objectifs de Year 4 (P4).
note: Objectifs repris du syllabus (en anglais). « revisions » = objectifs de P3 liés au thème ; « defis » = objectifs de P5 liés au thème. Ont été écartés les objectifs impossibles à évaluer par un quiz (étudier un écosystème sur le terrain, construire une station météo, mener des expériences). Le volet « Puberté » de P5 n'est jamais utilisé en défi. Les chapitres du programme sont regroupés en 4 thèmes ; chaque objectif est précédé du nom de son chapitre.

objectifs: Les écosystèmes – Describe the interaction between living things and the environment (e.g. a park, a pond, a forest)
Les écosystèmes – Become familiar with and describe a food chain as a feeding relationship in an ecosystem
Climat et météo – Describe the relationship between weather and climate
Climat et météo – Give characteristics of and compare different climatic regions
Climat et météo – Read air pressure on a barometer
Climat et météo – Know the various elements included when forecasting weather (e.g. clouds, air pressure, wind)
Climat et météo – Name and describe the instruments required to forecast the weather
Les paysages – Describe landscapes from different regions of the world (vegetation, human construction, relief)
Les paysages – Describe the impact of climate on landscapes
Protéger l'environnement – Describe and discuss the need to preserve nature (e.g. national parks, habitats)
Protéger l'environnement – Recognise the necessity to reduce the impact of human activity on the environment
Protéger l'environnement – Explain why it is important to be environmentally friendly (e.g. recycling, reducing carbon footprint)
revisions: Les écosystèmes – Describe the different stages of the reproduction of plants (e.g. from flower to fruit, from cones to trees)
Les écosystèmes – Be aware of the importance of insects in the reproduction process of plants
Climat et météo – Describe the water cycle
Climat et météo – Revise the different states of water and their role in the cycle
Les paysages – Describe and compare the landscape of a town with that of the countryside
Protéger l'environnement – Sort various materials for recycling
Protéger l'environnement – Describe the process of recycling and explain the benefits of recycling to the community
defis: Climat et météo – Research a natural phenomenon (e.g. storm, hurricane, flood, drought)
Les paysages – Describe reliefs of European countries using a map
Les paysages – Describe landscapes from different regions of Europe
Protéger l'environnement – Become familiar with the UN Global Goals for Sustainable Development

objectifs: L'œil et la vue – Describe the function of the eye and know the names of the main parts
L'œil et la vue – Describe the connection between light and sight
L'œil et la vue – Develop an awareness of the health aspects concerning sight (e.g. reduced sight, colour blindness)
L'œil et la vue – Discover how people deprived of sight participate in society
Nutrition et digestion – Outline reasons for the importance of nutrition for the body
Nutrition et digestion – Describe the digestive system and know the names of the main organs
Nutrition et digestion – Describe the connection between nutrition and digestion
Nutrition et digestion – Develop an awareness of health aspects concerning nutrition and digestion
revisions: L'œil et la vue – Describe the function of the ear and know the names of the main parts
L'œil et la vue – Become familiar with how sound is produced
Nutrition et digestion – Describe the skeleton and know names of the major bones
Nutrition et digestion – Describe how the skeleton and muscles function in relation to one another
defis: Nutrition et digestion – Recognise and describe the connection between respiration and circulation (the blood carries nutrients and oxygen to the whole body)

objectifs: L'électricité – Recognise some different sources of electricity
L'électricité – Recognise where electricity is used (e.g. at school, at home, in society)
L'électricité – Construct a simple electrical circuit (read and complete circuit diagrams: battery, bulb, wires, switch)
L'électricité – Carry out simple experiments with electricity (e.g. conductors and insulators)
L'électricité – Become aware of how some common electrical appliances work
L'électricité – Predict what will happen when doing an experiment on electricity - formulate hypotheses
L'électricité – Become aware of the dangers of electricity
L'énergie – Recognise concrete examples of how energy changes from one form to another
L'énergie – Establish that energy may be transferred in different ways
L'énergie – Identify and discuss simple energy chains (e.g. sun-plants-animals)
L'énergie – Identify and discuss where energy is used in daily life and from where energy comes
L'énergie – Name different types of sustainable energy and describe their main use
revisions: L'électricité – Describe the properties of magnets
L'électricité – Learn that magnets can attract or repel magnetic materials
L'énergie – Become aware that recycled materials (e.g. paper, glass, plastic) are used to produce new products
defis: L'énergie – Identify and explore how objects and materials may be moved (e.g. pushing, pulling, rollers, gears)

objectifs: Se repérer dans le temps – Develop an understanding of time and chronology so as to place people, objects and events within a broad historical sequence
Se repérer dans le temps – Record people and events in the past using a variety of simple timelines
Se repérer dans le temps – Use words, phrases and conventions associated with the recording of dates and time (e.g. BC, AD, age, period, century)
Le Moyen Âge – Become familiar with and describe aspects of people's lives in the Middle Ages (e.g. homes, clothes, farming, food, leisure)
Le Moyen Âge – Know stories of famous individuals from the period
Le Moyen Âge – Understand and explain the feudal system
revisions: Se repérer dans le temps – Record the different ages of Pre-History on appropriate timelines
Se repérer dans le temps – List the main characteristics of each period (e.g. Stone Age, Bronze Age)
Le Moyen Âge – Become familiar with and describe some aspects of the lives of people in prehistoric times
defis: Se repérer dans le temps – Become familiar with aspects of an era of change (e.g. Voyages of Discovery, French Revolution)
Le Moyen Âge – Voyages of Discovery: recognise ways in which the everyday lives of people changed
